April 1st, 2026[Dashboard](https://www.artillery.io/changelog/tag/dashboard)


# Performance Trends on individual test runs


A[Performance Trends](https://www.artillery.io/changelog/performance-trends-http) overview is now available on individual test runs. Open a test report to see how its key performance metrics compare across recent runs of the same test.
